<b>Rosary Strings</b> are [[Items (Silksong)#Consumables|consumable items]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==
Can be used from the inventory to gain {{R|60}}.

Strung Rosaries are not dropped upon death.

== How to Acquire ==
Rosary Strings can be purchased for {{R|80}} from various [[NPCs (Silksong)#Merchants|merchants]] and [[Rosary]] stringing machines found across [[Pharloom]], both of which have unlimited supplies.

Three Rosary Strings may also be found by interacting with glowing item spots.

== Trivia ==
* While having 20 Rosary Strings in the inventory, attempting to buy more from a machine will cause the {{R|80}} to be spent, but no additional strings will be received. Merchants will not sell them while at max capacity.
* In the 2019 <i>Silksong</i> demo, Rosary Strings had the description of <i>"Short string of rosaries. The string can be broken and the rosaries used to trade."</i><ref name="doc">[https://docs.google.com/document/d/10wyWpWJAtbRUSrOstN4e1l09mtx-vrjU_IiqdB2QGyc Everything we know about Hollow Knight: Silksong] (June 13th, 2022)</ref>
** According to a player of the demo, they gave {{R|40}} instead of {{R|60}} when broken in that build,<ref> [https://discord.com/channels/283467363729408000/484683488503529472/598886444504711188 Discord message] (July 2019)</ref> aligning with the [[Rosaries#Trivia|lower value Rosary item discussed in ''EDGE'' Magazine]].
